in_marathi.name: Karanvir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karanvir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Karan means 'bringer' in Sanskrit, and Vir means 'happiness' or 'power'. This name is derived from the Mahabharata where Arjuna is given the name Karan by Lord Krishna. The name is believed to bring happiness and success to the bearer.
